events.title: @iLabAfrica AI & Cybersecurity Innovation Workshop
events.description: Hands-on @iLabAfrica technical workshop on applied AI security, cloud defense, and campus innovation prototyping.

events.title: Strathmore AI & Machine Learning Annual Colloquium
events.description: Keynote research symposium featuring live demonstrations of predictive campus analytics, computer vision, and NLP systems built by Strathmore SCES final-year researchers.

events.title: Final Year IS Project Defense & Poster Exhibition
events.description: Official BSc Informatics & Computer Science project defense showcase evaluated by SCES faculty panels and industry supervisors.

events.title: Cybersecurity & Cloud Threat Hunting Bootcamp
events.description: Intensive hands-on blue-team defense lab covering zero-trust network architecture, SIEM log analysis, and penetration testing.

events.title: Fintech & Africa's Talking API Developer Hackathon
events.description: 24-hour sprint building USSD, Priority SMS, and mobile payment solutions using Africa's Talking and Daraja APIs.

events.title: Annual Engineering & Tech Graduate Career Fair
events.description: Connect directly with hiring managers from Safaricom, Microsoft ADC, Google Nairobi, Deloitte, and Equity Bank for internships and graduate roles.

events.title: Global Tech CV Clinic & Mock Technical Interviews
events.description: One-on-one resume reviews and whiteboard data-structure interview coaching with alumni engineers from leading tech firms.

events.title: Inter-Faculty Chancellor's Cup Football & Rugby Finals
events.description: Championship showdown between SCES Titans and SIMS Warriors followed by the trophy presentation at Madaraka grounds.

events.title: East Africa Quantitative Finance & Data Science Summit
events.description: Executive panel exploring algorithmic trading, credit risk modeling, and central bank digital currencies across East African markets.

events.title: CEO Fireside Chat: Leading Digital Transformation in Africa
events.description: Evening executive leadership dialogue with C-suite leaders on scaling enterprise governance and AI adoption across African corporations.

events.title: Data Privacy, AI Regulation & Kenya Data Protection Act Symposium
events.description: Legal and technical debate with the Office of the Data Protection Commissioner (ODPC) on algorithmic accountability and citizen privacy rights.

events.title: Strathmore Annual Cultural Week Gala & Concert
events.description: Celebration of international diversity featuring culinary showcases, traditional performances, and live campus musical acts.

events.title: Student Townhall & Campus Welfare Open Forum
events.description: Direct Q&A session between the 16th Student Council Executive, Dean of Students, and student body regarding academic policies and campus facilities.

events.title: Kotlin, Flutter & Gemini Android DevFest Strathmore
events.description: Hands-on mobile engineering codelab building cross-platform apps with on-device Gemini Nano and Firebase Cloud Messaging.

events.title: Open Source & Kubernetes Cloud Native Study Jam
events.description: Practical container orchestration workshop deploying microservices on Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE) and Docker.

events.title: Student Startup Pitch Deck & Venture Capital Demo Day
events.description: Ten student-founded startups pitch to Nairobi angel investors and VC funds for seed grants up to KES 1,500,000.

events.title: Green Campus Solar & E-Waste Recycling Innovation Drive
events.description: Campus sustainability drive collecting electronic waste for safe refurbishment and showcasing student clean-energy prototypes.
